Volunteer

There is a place for you here.

01

Become a Mentor

Build a one-on-one relationship with a young person. You don't need prior experience, just consistency, care, and belief in their potential. We provide training in trauma-informed mentorship and mental health support.

02

Mental Health Support

If you're a counselor, therapist, or mental health professional, we need your expertise. Provide workshops, group support, or consultation to strengthen our programming.

03

Academic Tutoring

Help young people succeed in the classroom. Whether math, English, science, or social studies, your expertise directly impacts their academic trajectory and confidence.

04

Coaching

Lead our basketball programs. We provide training in athletic development and mental resilience. Your job is to develop young athletes, model excellence, and build character.

05

Program Support

Help run after-school programs. From activity planning to meal prep to creating a welcoming, supportive environment, every role matters.

06

Skills and Expertise

Teach young people about your profession or passion. Career talks, workshops, and professional mentoring opens doors and expands possibilities.

Getting started

All it takes is showing up.

All volunteers undergo a background screening to ensure youth safety. We provide training, ongoing support, and clear expectations. Your role will be meaningful and your impact will be real.
